name: CYLD lysine 63 deubiquitinase
pathways: negative regulation of canonical NF-kappaB signal transduction
negative regulation of non-canonical NF-kappaB signal transduction

function.text: CYLD encodes ubiquitin carboxyl-terminal hydrolase CYLD. Annotated molecular activities include K63-linked deubiquitinase activity and cysteine-type deubiquitinase activity. It participates in negative regulation of canonical NF-kappaB signal transduction and negative regulation of non-canonical NF-kappaB signal transduction.

germline.text: Strong or definitive GenCC assertions link constitutional variants to Brooke-Spiegler syndrome (autosomal dominant); familial cylindromatosis (autosomal dominant).

somatic.text: Reported somatic alteration contexts include Cylindrocarcinoma; Spiradenocarcinoma; Follicular dendritic cell sarcoma. The alteration class and exact variant must be assessed in the disease context.

function.text: CYLD encodes ubiquitin carboxyl-terminal hydrolase CYLD. It participates in negative regulation of canonical NF-kappaB signal transduction and negative regulation of non-canonical NF-kappaB signal transduction. Functional annotations also associate the protein with K63-linked deubiquitinase activity and cysteine-type deubiquitinase activity.

germline.text: Pathogenic germline variants are associated with Brooke-Spiegler syndrome (autosomal dominant); familial cylindromatosis (autosomal dominant).

somatic.text: Somatic alterations involving CYLD have been reported in cylindrocarcinoma, spiradenocarcinoma, and follicular dendritic cell sarcoma.
